tasks.title: Wire fragment.NewReassembler in main.go + spawn expiry goroutine + shared instance into both webhook handlers
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/002-mo-fragment-reassembly/{requirements.md, design.md}. SECOND: edit cmd/meshsat-hub/main.go to: (REQ-100) instantiate `fragment.NewReassembler(5*time.Minute)` exactly once during startup; (REQ-101) call `rbHandler.SetReassembler(reassembler)` before the HTTP router starts; (REQ-102) call `clHandler.SetReassembler(reassembler)` against the SAME instance; (REQ-103) spawn a goroutine that calls `reassembler.Expire()` every 60 seconds, gated on shutdown context; (REQ-111) call `reassembler.Stop()` from the graceful-shutdown path. No new files outside main.go. Tests in cmd/meshsat-hub/main_test.go (if it exists) OR a new small smoke test verifying SetReassembler is called.

tasks.title: Augment fragment.Reassembler with audit + Prometheus + duplicate detection hooks
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/002-mo-fragment-reassembly/{requirements.md, design.md, contracts/schemas/fragment-event.json, acceptance/fragment-reassembly.feature}. SECOND: extend internal/fragment/fragment.go to: (REQ-112) emit `hub_fragment_received_total{state=buffered|reassembled|error|timeout|duplicate}` Prometheus counter — accept a Prometheus registerer or a no-op interface, do NOT hard-couple to metrics package; (REQ-113) detect duplicate (imei, message_id, fragment_index) arrivals as no-op; (REQ-107) return error path returns typed error so caller can write audit entry; (REQ-108) Expire emits a callback (registered via SetTimeoutCallback) that the caller wires to audit.Service. Tests cover duplicate detection, expiry callback, all 5 counter states. Existing fragment_test.go stays passing.

tasks.title: Wire RockBLOCK + Cloudloop handlers to call AddFragment + publish reassembled bytes downstream
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/002-mo-fragment-reassembly/{requirements.md, design.md, contracts/asyncapi.yaml}. SECOND: in both internal/rockblock/handler.go AND internal/cloudloop/webhook.go, locate the MO ingress path AFTER body decode + HMAC verify and BEFORE mo/raw publish. (REQ-104) When `fragment.IsFragment(rawBytes)` is true, call `h.reassembler.AddFragment(imei, rawBytes)`. (REQ-105) If reassembled bytes returned non-nil, set rawBytes := reassembled + add `was_reassembled=true` and `fragments_count=N` fields to the published mo/raw + mo/decoded messages. (REQ-106) If reassembled nil + no error, return early with INFO log `msg=fragment buffered, waiting for more`. (REQ-107) If error returned, call audit.Log(...) with type=fragment.error + return without publishing. Both handlers do this identically — extract a helper if it reduces duplication. Update WebhookMOMessage + WebhookRawMessage Go structs in both packages to add was_reassembled + fragments_count fields.

tasks.title: GET /api/fragments/inflight endpoint + tenant filter
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/002-mo-fragment-reassembly/{requirements.md, contracts/openapi.yaml, contracts/schemas/fragment-group.json}. SECOND: implement internal/api/fragments.go exposing `GET /api/fragments/inflight`. (REQ-109) Returns in-flight fragment groups as an array per fragment-group.json schema. (REQ-110) Filters by `tenant_id` JWT claim using the existing auth middleware pattern. Use the existing readJSON pattern for any future POST endpoints; this is a GET so just standard query handling. Mount the route in the existing router (likely cmd/meshsat-hub/main.go or wherever bridges/devices routes are mounted). Add @Summary/@Tags/@Router Swagger annotations matching repo convention. Tests cover the happy path + tenant-filter behavior.
